text:
Here's your first step! 👇

**Step 1 of 7 — Find the next free port**

Look at the black bar with the small colored plastic wire slots (those are called IDC terminals). Find the first group of **8 slots that has NO wires** pushed into it yet — the used ports will have colored wires already visible in them.

**Before you go any further — quick safety check:**
If you see any scorching, melted plastic, or smell anything burning in that panel, **stop immediately** and let me know.

---

Once you've spotted the empty port, take a close-up photo showing those 8 empty colored slots clearly, and send it to me! 📸
